scripts.prepare: lefthook install || echo 'Note: Git hooks not installed, please run: pnpm exec lefthook install' >&2
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @roedy/web sync && eslint . && prettier --check apps packages scripts *.js *.json
scripts.format: pnpm --filter @roedy/web sync && prettier --write apps packages scripts *.js *.json && eslint --fix .
scripts.licenses:server: mkdir -p target && cargo about generate --format json --locked --features roedy-mail-server/embed-web -o target/licenses-server.json
